# Best desk charging station for a laptop, phone and watch

**Top pick: ESR 100W 6-in-1 Charging Station with MagSafe + CryoBoost.** It's the only single unit in these results that handles all three: a laptop (USB-C), a phone (MagSafe pad), and a watch (dedicated Apple Watch charger). It also has an AirPods pad.

- **Price:** $164.99 list, or about $135.30 with code PARTNER18 (18% off, no minimum, expires 2026-12-31). Dealectric last tested the code on 2026-10-22.
- **Laptop power:** 100 W total from a GaN charger. The full 100 W on one USB-C port needs the pads idle. While the pads charge, the laptop gets up to 65 W, or 45 W if the second USB-C port is also in use.
- **Who it suits:** Laptops that charge at 65 W or less, such as a MacBook Air or a 13-14" ultrabook. A 16" MacBook Pro will charge slowly while the pads are in use.
- **Buy:** [ESR 100W 6-in-1 Charging Station](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-100w-6-in-1-magsafe-cryoboost-station)

Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/best-desk-charging-station-laptop-phone-watch-2026-usb-c-laptop-power-delivery-3). That page's "only one with a watch charger" claim is based on its own product records, not the whole market. The buy link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy.

## If you need more laptop power: Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 (140 W)
- One USB-C port delivers 140 W, enough for a 16" MacBook Pro. It also has a retractable 100 W cable and a Qi2 phone pad.
- It has **no watch charger**, so you'd plug your watch's own cable into a spare port.
- It was **sold out** on Baseus's US store at verification. The price is $149.99, with no working code.
- [Baseus Nomos 5-in-1 140W](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-nomos-5-in-1-140w-qi2)

## Alternative: pair a wireless stand with a laptop charger or hub
If you want better phone and watch charging, or a laptop with higher wattage needs, split the job in two:
- **Phone, watch and AirPods:** WIRED's [3-in-1 charger roundup](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/) names the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand best overall ($109, 15 W phone charging, 36 W adapter included). Its budget pick is the ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (about $40 on sale).
- **Cheaper stand:** StandDeskLab picks the [Anker MagGo 3-in-1](https://standdesklab.com/accessories/best-desk-charging-station/) ($89.99 list, around $67-70 on sale).
- **Laptop:** The same StandDeskLab guide lists the Anker 341 USB-C Hub (about $40) with up to 100 W passthrough charging.

These sites link to Amazon through buttons I can't see, so the links above go to the review pages rather than the products. Wireless prices vary a lot, so check the current price.

## Quick take
- Laptop at 65 W or less and you want one tidy unit: **ESR 100W 6-in-1**.
- Power-hungry laptop (16" MacBook Pro or similar): a 140 W charger like the Baseus Nomos, plus a separate wireless stand for your phone and watch.
- Android phone or non-Apple watch: the MagSafe and Apple Watch pads won't help much. Check Qi2 support for your phone and look for a wired option for your watch.

If you tell me your laptop model and whether you use an iPhone and Apple Watch, I can narrow this to one pick.
